title: Longevity & Mortality Forecasting

blueprintSignals.name: Age-period-cohort effects
blueprintSignals.definition: decomposition of log mortality into age, period and cohort terms
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: The three effects are not fully identifiable, so impose a documented constraint

blueprintSignals.name: Population improvement
blueprintSignals.definition: national mortality improvement rate by age band over the last 10 years

blueprintSignals.name: Portfolio experience ratio
blueprintSignals.definition: actual deaths divided by expected deaths for the portfolio
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Credibility is low for small portfolios, so blend

blueprintSignals.name: Cause-of-death mix
blueprintSignals.definition: share of deaths due to cardiovascular disease and cancer by age
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Data lag by one to two years

label: For "Longevity & Mortality Forecasting": Forecast mortality improvement by age and cohort for pension and annuity pricing and reserving. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: A back-test through stable years makes any trend model look accurate.
